questionText:
Which of the following were not the alternative centers of political and economic power that emerged after disintegration of USSR?

(A) European Union
(B) African Union
(C) Association of South East Asian Nations
(D) South East Asian Treaty Organisation

options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately solves the problem for The End of Bipolarity.
Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For The End of Bipolarity (Alternative Centres of Power):
NCERT Class 12 Contemporary World Politics (Chapter 4: Alternative Centres of Power): Following the collapse of the Soviet Union, the primary alternative centers of economic and political power evaluated to counter US hegemony were the European Union (EU), the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN), and China (and later BRICS/India). The African Union was not presented as a major alternative pole in this chapter, and SEATO (South East Asia Treaty Organisation) was a Western Cold War military pact created in 1954 and dissolved in 1977. Therefore, (B) and (D) were NOT among these alternative power centers.

Therefore, option (A) is the correct answer.
